name: extract sign tables retry
command:
cat /tmp/sign_extract.py | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/sign_extract.py && python3 ~/bonsai2/asm/sign_extract.py ~/bonsai2/models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf && ls -la /tmp/sign*.bin && cmp /tmp/sign5120.bin /tmp/sign5120.bin && python3 -c "
import struct
a=open(\"/tmp/sign5120.bin\",\"rb\").read()
v=struct.unpack(\"<%df\"% (len(a)//4), a)
print(\"5120: n=%d all_pm1=%s\" % (len(v), all(x in (1.0,-1.0) for x in v)))"' 2>&1 | head -12
